resources.string: No alarms scheduled. Add one now!

Welcome to Danny's Alarm!

FEATURES:
1. ADD ALARM: Use the (+) button. You can set the time by typing directly on the numbers.
2. REPEAT: Select the days of the week you want the alarm to ring.
3. EXCEPTIONS: Click "Exceptions" to open a calendar and select specific days when the alarm should NOT ring, even if it's a scheduled day.
4. MELODY: Choose any system sound or local music file from your device.
5. SETTINGS: Customize the app with any background color or force Dark Mode.
6. LANGUAGES: Change the app language instantly from the globe icon.

Enjoy a professional waking experience!
